title: 9.6.0 | Patch Notes
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/b30ddb8d736ddebabb52bb222a935782db96fe73.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]As a result of engine updates, the download file size for this update will be larger than normal.[/p][/*][*][p]The Legion has been re-enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Map weighting has been adjusted in order for maps to have an equal chance of spawning - Realm Repeat Prevention remains in effect.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Diminishing Returns Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While in a Trial, repeated positive or negative gameplay modifiers and status effects are now affected by diminishing returns.[/p][/*][*][p]Identical Killer and Survivor modifiers granted by Powers, Items, Perks and Offerings will now be reduced progressively as they become stacked.[/p][list][*][p]The following apply diminishing returns [b]only within[/b] their role:[/p][list][*][p]Negative action speed modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]Positive skill check chance modifiers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following are [b]excluded entirely [/b]from diminishing returns:[/p][list][*][p]Modifiers granted from Add-ons[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The gameplay modifier with the highest absolute value is always applied, while lesser ones are progressively lowered to a percentage of their original value.[/p][list][*][p]The game prioritizes the highest values, reducing the impact of lesser ones.[/p][list][*][p]1st value (highest) - 100% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]2nd value - 50% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]3rd value - 25% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]4th value - 12.5% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]5th value and up - 5% of modifier[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Game manual updated to include information on diminishing returns.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]1v4 Play While You Wait Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the option to "Play While You Wait" to the default 1v4 game mode.[/p][list][*][p]While searching for a match as Killer, you will receive the option to Play While You Wait.[/p][/*][*][p]This allows you to play a match as a Survivor while saving your place in the Killer queue.[/p][/*][*][p]After finishing your Survivor match, you will automatically be returned to your place in the Killer queue.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Progress Bar Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The progress bar for interactions has a new animation to reinforce the speed differences[/p][/*][*][p]The color has been updated so it represents the speed of the interaction, becoming yellow if faster than normal, and red if slower than normal[/p][list][*][p]Previously, the color was dependent on the individual contributor. Ie. a player could see the bar red even when going faster[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Visible Team Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Match Details have been updated to show the loadout of players of a same team[/p][list][*][p]Perks[/p][/*][*][p]Items and addons[/p][/*][*][p]Offerings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Match Details have been updated to show the Killer to all Survivors when one of the following occurs:[/p][list][*][p]Any Survivor enters a chase[/p][/*][*][p]Any Survivor loses a health state[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Elements can be hovered to display their descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]The loadout of the opposite team is not displayed until the match is over, following the final Score screen behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Spectator mode[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While in Spectator mode, most elements in the HUD can be hovered to display their description[/p][list][*][p]Perks[/p][/*][*][p]Items[/p][/*][*][p]Add ons[/p][/*][*][p]Goals[/p][/*][*][p]Status Effects[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Auras Customization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New aura types are available for color customization[/p][list][*][p]Highlighted elements (e.g. as The Xenomorph, looking at specific Control Stations)[/p][/*][*][p]Surfaced elements (e.g. Generators shown by [i]Deja Vu[/i], or because of [i]Eruption[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Marked elements (e.g. as The Xenomorph, marking a Control Station)[/p][/*][*][p]Killer objects (e.g. The Hag's traps, The Singularity's Biopods)[/p][/*][*][p]Breakable walls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Blight[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased The Blight's default movement speed to [b]4.4 m/s[/b] [i](was 4.6 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Breaking a Downed Pallet now reduces Rush tokens down to 2 below maximum, and resets current Rush token recharge to 0%.[/p][list][*][p]Includes basic-break and special-break Killer actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Power description updated to reflect change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Doctor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased delay of Shock Therapy attack to [b]0.75 seconds [/b][i](was 0.8 seconds)[/i][b].[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Cannibal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum Chainsaw Sweep speed to [b]5.45 m/s[/b] [i](was 5.35 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Ghost Face[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased the cooldown of Night Shroud to [b]15 seconds[/b] [i](was 17 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Demogorgon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Shred's movement speed to [b]19 m/s[/b] [i](was 18.4 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Shred's turn rate to [b]55 degrees [/b]per second [i](was 27.5 degrees per second)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Undetectable after traversing the Upside Down to [b]12 seconds[/b] [i](was 5 seconds)[/i]. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Dredge[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased movement speed while charging Reign of Darkness to[b] 4 m/s [/b][i](was 3.8m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Mastermind[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased recovery time of Virulent Bound to [b]2.7 seconds[/b] [i](was 3 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased charge time per token to [b]5 seconds[/b] [i](was 5.5 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of the Chain Bound window to [b]2.5 seconds[/b] [i](was 2 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Skull Merchant[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added support to when embedded in Survivors to [b]8 seconds [/b][i](was 10 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased battery consumption per Camera in use to [b]6%[/b] [i](was 7%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased battery consumption upon Survivor teleport to [b]12%[/b] [i](was 15%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Key binding for Grab Axe button updated to use Power input [i](was Attack input)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Add-on Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Nurse's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heavy Panting (Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Extends the duration of a lunge after more than one blink by [b]10%[/b] [i](was 30%)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Ghost Face's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Walleye's ground had superfluous collision.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Changes from PTB
[/b][/h2][h3][b]Diminishing Returns Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Following PTB, the following gameplay modifiers now apply diminishing returns [b]only within[/b] their role:[/p][list][*][p]Negative action speed modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]Positive skill check chance modifiers[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: Thank you for your feedback during the 9.6.0 PTB period! Following reports, we have appended the diminishing returns system to exclude specific modifiers to maintain intended interactions. Notably, negative modifiers will now only apply within the same role. We discovered during PTB that negative modifiers from Killer and Survivor sources were reducing each other, causing self-inflicted penalties to be lessened and gameplay outcomes not working as intended.[/i][/p][p][i]On 9.6.0 PTB, for example, the self-inflicted 30% cleansing speed penalty from the Survivor Perk Calm Spirit was being reduced by 50% when calculated against the starting 60% cleansing speed penalty from the Killer Perk Hex: Thrill of the Hunt. Similarly, we found that positive modifiers for skill checks also needed this intervention.
